style: Style: an original head-and-shoulders portrait in the manner of a 19th-century Thai Buddhist temple mural (Rattanakosin era): fine gold-leaf contour lines, flat mineral pigments (red ochre, indigo, malachite green, ochre yellow, chalk white), dark green background with a few stylised leaves, old wall plaster with faint cracks. Three-quarter view, centred, calm and dignified, modestly and fully dressed. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, not a cartoon. No text, no letters, no signature, no border.

items.suddhodana: King Suddhodana of the Sakya clan, a dignified middle-aged king with a tall pointed Thai crown (chada), gold necklaces and a brocade royal jacket.
items.maya: Queen Maha Maya, a gentle young queen with a pointed crown and gold ornaments, wearing a fully covering embroidered sabai shawl over both shoulders and a brocade upper garment.
items.asita: The old hermit Asita: long white beard, tall coiled hair knot, tiger-skin cloth over one shoulder, kind wise eyes.
items.kondanna: Kondanna, a young Brahmin with a topknot and a white cloth over one shoulder, raising one finger, serious and certain.
items.channa: Channa, the prince's loyal charioteer, a young courtier in a simple red and gold jacket and a small pointed cap.
items.bimbisara: King Bimbisara of Magadha, a mature king with a tall pointed crown and a dark green brocade jacket, respectful expression.
items.ascetic: The ascetic Siddhattha after leaving the palace: a young man with short cropped hair, no crown, no halo, in a plain saffron robe over the left shoulder, calm and determined.
items.sujata: Sujata, a young village woman of a wealthy household, hair in a bun with a flower, modest dress and shawl, holding a golden bowl.
items.mara: Mara, the demon king of temptation: dark green skin, tall pointed crown, fierce eyes and small fangs, ornate armour, in the manner of a Thai mural yaksha (not gory, not frightening for children).
